_comment: Zero-shot CLIP prompts per civic issue code (codes must exist in backend/app/rules/civic_issue_taxonomy.json). Issue prompts are averaged into one embedding per issue; each prompt of a 'reject' class (NO_CIVIC_ISSUE) is kept as its own embedding so unrelated photos (pets, food, selfies, indoor scenes...) are recognised. Rebuild after editing: python -m backend.ml.build_clip_model
